description.value: Capilano Cafe Market is a family-run deli and café on Capilano Road in North Vancouver, built around organic espresso, freshly made Italian-inspired paninis and sandwiches, and daily baked goods. The space includes a welcoming indoor area and a patio, making it a neighbourhood gathering spot on the North Shore. They also provide full catering services for corporate meetings and private events across the Lower Mainland.
